text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Pager: customer=voyager env=private-vpc service=ingress/egress high error rate (5xx spike). Link: https://redwood.ops/alerts/5301234567
netops-oncall: ack — I'm on it, investigating NAT/egress path and NLB health.
customer-sre-voyager: impact: ~60% inference calls 14:58->15:03 failing with 502/TLS resets to model endpoints in zone-a. customers noticing elevated latency too.
eng-runtime-lead: seeing TLS handshake resets in runtime logs, KV cache miss rate jumped. NLB source IPs in logs differ from expected AZ pool.
sam: checking route tables and recent infra automation runs, pulling audit. quick look: route-table rtb-0voyager changed at 11:02 UTC by infra-automation.
jess: oncall handoff in 15m — if we need an emergency change that affects routing/TTL call it now.
netops-oncall: dug in: traffic egress SNATing via deprecated NAT instance nat-0old which is in a different AZ -> asymmetric return path and conntrack mismatch. that explains TLS resets.
leila: sec note: noticed an ephemeral SG deny rule added this morning by robot that blocks high ephemeral ports used by ALB/NLB probes (>61000). reverting now.
customer-sre-voyager: ALB health shows OK upstream but NLB target health intermittent. are probes hitting wrong backend now due to SNAT?
eng-runtime-lead: yes — recommend immediate mitigations: 1) switch routes from nat-0old -> nat-0new, 2) flush conntrack on nat-0old, 3) rollback SG deny, 4) short DNS weight shift to fallback pool (TTL 30s) to reduce load on affected AZ.
sam: applying route change now:
```
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0voyager --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --instance-id nat-0new
```
deploy-bot: route change submitted (change r-03abc), state=INSYNC.
netops-oncall: conntrack flush issued against nat-0old and session table cleared. monitoring for resets.
customer-sre-voyager: error rate down to ~12% within 4 minutes, TLS resets ~1-2/min. customer reporting significant improvement.
eng-runtime-lead: applying Route53 quick weight: shift 20% -> fallback-hostpool in us-west, TTL 30s. keep for 1hr then reassess.
leila: SG deny rule rolled back and automation patch queued to ignore these managed ALB/NLB SGs. SOC ticket created: SOC-VOY-2026-12.
jess: prepping handoff notes for @mike, summary + mitigation steps posted to customer ticket ESCAL-VOY-2026. Will transfer in 10m.
mike: taking over, ack. next steps: watch for automation reintroducing nat-0old, coord postmortem, prepare rollback plan if route flips.
customer-sre-voyager: please include timeline, root cause (infra automation pointed route table to deprecated NAT causing asymmetric SNAT/conntrack), mitigation (route fix, conntrack flush, SG rollback, DNS weight shift), and recommended long-term guardrails.
incident-bot: Incident state: MITIGATED -> monitoring. Severity set to Sev2. Documenting timeline and assigning postmortem owners. :white_check_mark:
